estilo: Documentary photo, soft natural daylight, Brazilian home garden, realistic colors, sharp focus, no text, no logos

fotos.cena: Close-up of a man's hands wearing thick gloves, holding a folded cloth around a tall columnar cactus and cutting off its top with a knife
Close-up of a man's hands laying a cut columnar cactus top on a dry wooden shelf in an airy spot so the cut can heal; the small mascot figurine stands on the shelf next to it
Close-up of a man's hands planting a healed columnar cactus cutting upright in a pot of sandy soil
Small potted cactus with a dried, artificially dyed straw flower glued and pinned onto its top, close view
Astrophytum asterias, a flat spineless cactus like a sea urchin with 8 ribs and small white dots, in a clay pot
Melocactus with a woolly reddish cap (cephalium) on top bearing small flowers, in a pot
Rat tail cactus with long thin stems cascading over the edge of a hanging pot, with magenta flowers
Mammillaria bocasana clump covered in white spines and silky hairs like a pompom, in a small pot; the small mascot figurine sits on the rim of the pot
